headline: Police raid Starbucks Korea over 'Tank Day' promotion fiasco
summary: Officers searched the headquarters after complaints that a free-drink promo made light of the deadly 1980 Gwangju Uprising.
script: Police in South Korea have raided Starbucks' headquarters over a promotion that critics say made light of the Gwangju Uprising. The free-drink offer, nicknamed Tank Day, drew complaints from the public and survivors.
imageAlt: Police officers enter the Starbucks Korea headquarters in Seoul during the raid.
imageAltTwo: A Starbucks storefront in Seoul, illustrating the company's presence across the country.
